text:
Erica: Post-all-hands thread for infra Qs only (GPU supply, regions, autoscale). Keep short.
Sam: Quick top-line: hosted capacity is fine for current traffic; APAC quota spikes and H100 lead times remain the biggest risk. We're lining up two committed pools and a small EU buffer.
Carlos: For customer launches, can we pre-warm capacity instead of relying on autoscale?
Vikram: Yes 1 pre-warm flow is available: create a reservation object with a TTL and pre-warm hooks. We'll add a CLI helper.
Lina: How will cross-region failover affect egress cost visibility? We need to warn accounts.
Sam: Console will show per-route egress estimate and a "spillover cost" annotation when cross-region serving exceeds X% of traffic. Billing will surface a notice for persistent spillover.
Erica: Autoscale behavior: anyone concerned about oscillation with short bursts?
Vikram: We're moving to a layered approach: small burst token bucket (absorbs <30s spikes), then adaptive cooldown + gradual scale steps. Config draft:
```
autoscale:
  mode: layered
  burst_tokens_ms: 30000
  step_size: 2
  adaptive_cooldown: true
  cooldown_base_s: 60
```
Sam: Canary rollout plan: enable layered autoscaler in staging, then 10% of prod traffic, monitor fallback/latency for 48h before wider rollout.
Carlos: Who approves manual reserve increases for promo events?
Lina: Capacity-ops approves; infra-oncall executes. Use the "capacity bump" workflow in ops repo.
infra-bot: :information_source: Canaries created: autoscale-layered -> canary-10pct. Monitor: https://dash.internal/canaries/as-layered
Vikram: Telemetry: we'll emit per-request fields (served_region, model_variant, fallback_flag). Adding an alert for >5% fallback_rate in 10m.
Sam: Procurement note: A100 replenishment ~8 weeks; H100 gating by kernel validation (ETA Q3). Committed pools negotiated with two providers to reduce APAC volatility.
Erica: Action items: Sam -> publish committed pool terms; Vikram -> open PR with pre-warm CLI and autoscale config; Lina -> add cost-warning to onboarding docs; Carlos -> schedule pre-warm test for next promo.
infra-bot: :white_check_mark: Actions recorded: sam/committed-pools, vikram/autoscale-pr, lina/cost-warning, carlos/prewarm-test
Sam: Thanks all, will follow up in #eng-ops with links.
